is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles arabiensis, a major malaria vector species of the Gambiae complex in Africa (page 1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper focuses on predicting mosquito age using MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry and deep learning. It does not genotype any of the target insecticide-resistance markers (e.g., Vgsc, Ace-1, Rdl, GSTe2). It mentions kdr allele frequencies in the discussion (page 8) but only by citing previous studies (Dia et al. 2018).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype or allele frequency data for resistance markers are reported in the text, tables, or figures.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected as larvae from two sites in Senegal: Keur Massar (Senegal 1) and N'dofan (Senegal 2) (page 9).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study describing the development and validation of a new age-prediction method.

sub_country_location.evidence: Data are tied to Keur Massar health district (Dakar) and N'dofan health district (Keur Socé) with specific coordinates provided (page 9).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were conducted in November 2019 and December 2021 (page 9).

duplicate_risk.evidence: While the collection sites are part of established surveillance areas, the specific samples and MALDI-TOF analysis appear unique to this study.

supplement.evidence: The supplementary materials (Data S1-S8) contain data related to mass spectra and age prediction, but do not contain the missing insecticide-resistance genotype data required for eligibility.

assessment.summary: This study evaluates the use of MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry combined with deep learning to predict the age of field-collected Anopheles arabiensis mosquitoes from two sites in Senegal. While it provides detailed geographical and temporal data for the field populations, it does not report genotyping for any insecticide-resistance markers, focusing instead on protein fingerprinting for age estimation.
exclusion_reasons: Does not report results for any of the target insecticide-resistance markers.
